heading: Plugin Services
description: Containers that plugins run through Plugin Runtime. A stopped service stays stopped until you start it again; while it is stopped its plugin carries on without it.
empty: No enabled plugin runs a service.
external_notice: These services are managed outside Syrus in this deployment (for example on Kubernetes). Syrus shows their health but cannot stop or start them.
manager_unreachable: The runtime manager could not be reached, so this shows the last known state: {{error}}
confirm_stop: Stop {{service}}? {{plugin}} carries on without it until you start it again.
confirm_restart: Restart {{service}}? {{plugin}} carries on without it while it restarts.
volumes_description: Volumes plugin services keep their data in. Data whose service is not running -- a disabled or removed plugin -- can be deleted here.
confirm_delete_volume: Delete {{volume}}? Everything {{plugin}} stored there is gone for good; re-enabling it starts from scratch.
